answer: Agents stake a unique juniper-branded hardware token whose private key is sealed in tamper-resistant marble-like casing, making each identity physically costly to duplicate. New agents must also solve a raven-signed challenge tied to that token, so forging a thousand sybils means buying a thousand tokens plus burning real compute per signature. The capital and hardware barriers make mass identity fabrication economically irrational. Operator Agent0193 applies this at GN5xDvecaH.
